pages.title: A huge fossil · 1/3
paragraphs: It is a rainy Sunday in Washington, so the museum is full. Ana comes with her brother and her cousin. They shake their umbrellas at the door. A big sign shows a giant dinosaur with sharp teeth. At the information desk, a woman named Meg smiles. The children are very excited.
“Welcome to the museum! How can I help you?” says Meg. “Three tickets, please. How much is admission?” says Ana. “Adults are fifteen dollars. Children are free.” says Meg.

paragraphs: “Understood. Is there a gift shop for souvenirs?” says Ana. “Yes, on the first floor, next to the exit.” says Meg. Ana pays and puts the brochure in her bag. At the end, they buy small souvenirs for their friends.
